visualCharacteristics: Default: auto-fill grid of bordered image cards. icons: three centred columns (1192px max) with a 56px icon, Playfair title, text and an accent arrow link, separated by 1px vertical dividers. feature: three equal-height cards with a cover image on top and a dark plum body (beige title, white semibold text) with a red primary button anchored 25px from the bottom.
contentPattern: One row per card. Cell 1: image (icon for the icons variant). Cell 2: title (heading or bold paragraph), text, link (bold+italic = accent arrow link for icons, bold = primary button for feature).

usage.description: icons: resource/tool links such as 'Retirement planning resources'. feature: 'Additional resources' promo cards with images.

reuseGuidance: icons and feature are laid out for three cards per row; use multiples of three. Put the section heading as default content in a centered section.
